help_text:
ToolsGCP Resource Maker — Help

[What this tool does]
  Turns "I want ToolsGCP to list this app" into clean, structured data.
  When the form is filled in you can: generate a draft and send it to the author,
  append it to your local library, or save it as a private library.

[Required fields]
  Only two fields are required: Name and ID.
  Everything else may be left empty (empty fields are not written to the JSON and
  are not shown on the card). Empty fields only produce a hint — they never block you.

[How to fill it in]
  · Name: the app name, matching the official spelling. The ID is generated from it as you type.
  · ID: unique inside the library; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
  · Description: one line saying what the app is — shown on the card and as the small line in
    the detail page header.
  · About: the body of the detail page's "About" block, longer than the description (a few
    paragraphs on features, what makes it special, who it is for); stored in the JSON "intro"
    field and never shown on cards or in the list. If empty, the detail page falls back to
    the description.
  · Extra notes: anything that does not fit in the About text (use cases, requirements,
    caveats…); stored in the JSON "supplement" field and shown as a second paragraph right
    below the About text on the detail page.
  · Website: "example.com" is fine — https:// is added automatically.
  · Category: decides which group it appears under on the search page; you can type a new one.
  · Tags: filled automatically from the category until you edit them yourself;
    click "Follow category" to restore the link. "官方" shows as a gold badge.

[Images (icons)]
  Click "Import image" and pick a file — the tool does the rest:
  · the image is copied into the library icon folder (.ToolsGCP/Icon);
  · whatever the file was called, it is renamed after the Name field (e.g. LocalSend.png);
  · renaming the entry later renames the icon too — no manual file juggling;
  · if the name is taken, -2 / -3 is appended; existing icons are never overwritten;
  · the file is verified after copying.
  A square PNG of 256x256 or larger with transparency looks best; GIF works too (it animates).

[Listed at (listed_at)]
  Recorded automatically when an entry is first written to the library (e.g. 2026-09-21 00:40:14);
  editing an existing entry does not change it. The search page's
  "More filters → Updated" uses this field.

[What is the code?]
  Every entry gets a unique code (like TG-000001). Deploy manifests refer to apps by code,
  so please do not change the code of an existing entry.

[Output options]
  · Write to library: edits .ToolsGCP/ToolsGCP-Resources.json in place (always this one file,
                      no second library is created); a backup is written to .ToolsGCP/backups/.
  · Generate draft: writes ResourceDrafts/<id>/ with resource.json and the image, plus a zip of
                    the same name — just send that zip to the author.
  · Save as a standalone library: a complete JSON containing only this entry, handy as your own
                    private library (the image is copied along).

[Using the browse / delete page]
  · Double-click a cell (name, category, tags, website, repo, description, listed at…) to edit it
    in place; changes are saved automatically;
  · double-clicking the icon cell opens the image picker and renames the icon automatically;
  · the name cell cannot be emptied; clearing an optional field removes it from the JSON;
  · for bigger edits select a row and click "Load into the form" (or right-click it);
  · every write is backed up first, and deleting an entry also cleans up unused icons.

[Tip]
  Anything you change in the form updates the live preview on the right; a validation pass runs
  before generating or appending.
